<div class="card-body">
'''Ponda Baba''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ポンダ・バーバ</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ドクター・エヴァザンのいる位置カードで戦闘を行う場合、戦闘力を＋３できる。ただし、そこに相手のライトセーバーがない場合に限る。ポンダ・バーバが操縦している宇宙船の戦闘力は＋２される。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">クアラ（指のあるアクアリッシュ）の男性。殺し屋にして<u>密輸屋</u>。相棒のドクター・エヴァザンに、性能の悪い人工生体の義手を移植される。</span>''

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ponda Baba.

'''Card text:''' When battling at a site where [[Dr. Evazan]] is present, you may add 3 to Ponda Baba's power, but only if none of your opponent's lightsabers is there. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots.<ref name="jp-face" />

'''Lore:''' A male Quara (a fingered Aqualish), an assassin and smuggler. His partner Dr. Evazan fitted him with a poorly functioning bioprosthetic hand.<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Characteristics</h2>
* Male<ref name="jp-face" />
* Quara (Aqualish)<ref name="jp-face" />
* Smuggler<ref name="jp-face" />

<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The later [[Ponda Baba (Errata)|English errata]] says anything he pilots.<ref name="decipher-errata">[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, Ponda Baba entry.</ref>

Japanese-language printing of [[Ponda Baba]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].
